import subprocess
lane=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/sun-refutation.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'sources/sun-refutation.txt'],input=r.stdout,capture_output=True,text=True);assert w.returncode==0
